Original instance and fence"},{"id":"new_coord","type":"rectangle","label":"New coordinator
New fenced owner"},{"id":"store","type":"cylinder","label":"Authoritative ledger
Check lineage / owner / fence
inside EVERY mutation"},{"id":"gate","type":"rectangle","label":"Final broker gate
Deny new stale calls"},{"id":"old_broker","type":"rectangle","label":"Paused old broker
May retain an accepted claim"},{"id":"barrier","type":"rectangle","label":"Qualified physical stop / drain
or receiver-enforced fence"},{"id":"quiesce","type":"rectangle","label":"Quiescing scope
No replacement emission right
Conflicting disclosure withheld"},{"id":"upstream","type":"rectangle","label":"Upstream / receiver"},{"id":"note","type":"text","label":"Kubernetes election, lease expiry, or a new DB fence alone
do not stop old socket writes or undo an accepted remote effect."}],"edges":[{"id":"(old_coord -> store)[0]","source":"old_coord","target":"store","label":"Stale write / refund rejected","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(new_coord -> store)[0]","source":"new_coord","target":"store","label":"Acquire higher durable fence","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(old_coord -> gate)[0]","source":"old_coord","target":"gate","label":"New stale request rejected","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(store -> old_broker)[0]","source":"store","target":"old_broker","label":"Existing claim stays spent
never reset","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(old_broker -> upstream)[0]","source":"old_broker","target":"upstream","label":"Accepted in-flight work may still occur","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(new_coord -> quiesce)[0]","source":"new_coord","target":"quiesce","label":"Stop / receiver evidence unavailable","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(barrier -> quiesce)[0]","source":"barrier","target":"quiesce","label":"Required before stronger takeover guarantee","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"},{"id":"(gate -> barrier)[0]","source":"gate","target":"barrier","label":"Actual execution retirement evidence","sourceArrow":false,"targetArrow":true,"sourceMarker":"none","targetMarker":"triangle"}]}
